Job Title: Floral Production Manager & Head Designer
Company Name: Stemz Inc.
Location: Toronto, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-07-17
Job Type: full
Remote: yes
Salary: $70,000
Job URL: http://ca.indeed.com/job/floral-production-manager-head-designer-22224e44a1114240
Source: indeed
Job Description: ABOUT STEMZ

Stemz Inc. is a Toronto based event and floral design studio creating distinctive experiences for weddings, corporate events, brand activations and large scale installations. Our work brings together creativity, craftsmanship, detailed planning and flawless execution.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a confident and highly capable Senior Floral Production Manager \& Head Designer to lead our experienced floral production team and take ownership of the design floor, from advance planning and floral execution through to loading and installation at event sites.

This is a rare, practical leadership opportunity within a highly creative studio. The successful candidate will establish clear priorities, direct an experienced team and maintain accountability while protecting the collaborative, energetic and enjoyable culture that makes Stemz distinctive.

THE ROLE

What you will lead

TEAM LEADERSHIP \& RESOURCE PLANNING

* Lead, direct, mentor and support an experienced floral production team of approximately two to eight designers, depending on the production schedule.
* Set clear daily expectations, allocate work effectively and hold the team accountable for quality, efficiency and deadlines.
* Identify floral design capacity required for each production period and communicate those needs to the Staffing and Logistics Manager.
* Foster a positive, respectful and productive studio culture while remaining calm and decisive during demanding production periods.

PRODUCTION PLANNING \& OPERATIONS

* Create, maintain and continuously update the master Floral Production Plan in Microsoft Teams.
* Production plan major weddings and events approximately three to four weeks in advance, adjusting as event details evolve.
* Translate event requirements into daily workflow, priorities, designer assignments and achievable timelines.
* Monitor progress and reassign resources or priorities when requirements change.
* Oversee floral preparation and ensure completed designs are ready for an organized handoff to the logistics team.
* Maintain an organized, efficient and safe design floor that is ready for production.

FLORAL DESIGN \& QUALITY CONTROL

* Interpret approved creative concepts from the client creative leads and translate their vision into floral designs that are ready for production.
* Create floral samples and mockups for client presentations, weddings and events.
* Ensure production reflects approved samples, specifications and creative direction.
* Maintain Stemz standards for floral quality, proportion, mechanics, finishing and presentation.
* Guide designers and resolve creative or technical challenges during production.

CROSS DEPARTMENT COORDINATION

* Partner with client creative leads to confirm floral requirements, protect the approved creative vision and assess production feasibility.
* Coordinate with the Head Floral Buyer regarding availability, substitutions, quantities and ordering.
* Communicate floral production schedules, completed design requirements and installation plans to the appropriate departments.
* Identify concerns early and recommend practical solutions that protect the design intent, timeline and budget.

EVENT INSTALLATION

* Lead or assist with floral installations at weddings, corporate events and brand activations.
* Ensure designs are executed according to the approved concept and completed accurately and on schedule.
* Direct installation teams during large scale events or projects with demanding timelines.

INVENTORY, TOOLS \& STUDIO READINESS

* Monitor floral supplies, tools and consumable materials and arrange replenishment when required.
* Maintain organized inventory of silk flowers and floral supplies.
* Ensure tools, materials and work areas are properly maintained and ready for production.

WHAT YOU BRING

* A minimum of five years of professional floral design experience, including substantial wedding and event production experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading floral designers or a comparable creative production team.
* Advanced floral design ability and a strong understanding of mechanics, scale, colour, composition and premium finishing.
* Excellent planning, prioritization, delegation, communication and problem solving skills.
* Confidence directing experienced team members and making sound decisions under pressure.
* A collaborative and practical approach with exceptional attention to detail.
* Above all, we are looking for a generous, grounded and highly collaborative person who understands that exceptional work is created together. Our team culture is our greatest asset and protecting that culture is fundamental to this role.
* A valid driver’s license is preferred.

WORKING AT STEMZ

A singular opportunity in a remarkable studio

This is a full time position based in our studio. Event production requires flexibility, and the successful candidate must be available to work evenings, weekends and extended hours during peak production periods and event installations. Scheduling varies according to the event calendar and operational requirements.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The role includes the normal physical requirements associated with professional floral production and event installation: standing for extended periods; working in studio, and event environments; handling floral materials, vessels and production equipment; bending and reaching; and safely lifting and moving items used for events within reasonable workplace requirements.

COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS

Salary details will be shared with qualified candidates and will reflect the successful applicant’s experience and capabilities. This is an important role and will be reflected in the package. The full time position includes comprehensive healthcare benefits.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your résumé, floral design portfolio and professional references.

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Stemz Inc. welcomes applications from qualified candidates and is committed to an inclusive hiring process.

PLEASE NOTE: Weekend availability is required. Week day and weekend work will vary each week. One week's 40 hours may be contained within Mon \-Fri, and the next week may require the candidate to work both Sat and Sun as well as 3 other days throughout the week.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Extended health care
* Paid time off
* Vision care

Flexible language requirement:

* French not required

Work Location: In person

Source: indeed
Job Description: **Date Posted:** 07/17/2026
  
**Req ID:** 47859
  
**Faculty/Division:** Faculty of Arts \& Science
  
**Department:** Dept of Near \& Middle East.Civilizations
  
**Campus:** St. George (Downtown Toronto)
  
  

**Description:** Early Islamic architecture and art emerged from a variety of sources, including Roman\-Byzantine styles in Greater Syria (Al\-Sham) and the Sassanian architecture and art of pre\-Islamic Persia. During its formative phase, Islamic architecture and art were not limited to a single religion, period, place, or medium. Instead, they spanned multiple regions and encompassed a broad range of artistic fields, including architecture, mosaics, stucco, frescoes, ceramics, and woodwork, among others, each carrying significant spiritual, artistic, and practical meaning.
  
  

This course offers a detailed study of Islamic architecture and art from its earliest period at the beginning of Islam in the 7th century through the end of the Fatimid period in 1171 AD. It seeks to develop an understanding of early Islamic architecture and art within the Muslim city in the Middle East and al\-Andalucía in their broader cultural context, highlighting both their distinctive architectural, decorative, and artistic characteristics and their roots in Byzantine, Sassanian, and Arabic traditions, while examining how these elements evolved and developed their own forms in planning, architecture, and decorative techniques.

Job Description: **About Us:**

Pioneer Family Pools is a trusted retail leader specializing in swimming pools, hot tubs, patio furniture, related chemicals, accessories, and service. We are dedicated to helping customers realize the potential of their backyards, and we pride ourselves on providing exceptional products and family fun. As a tight\-knit, hard\-working, and collaborative team, we are passionate about our business and our customers. As an industry leader, we are we are proud to have more than 60 years’ experience in the business.

**Position Overview**

Pioneer Family Pools is seeking an experienced and versatile Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. This role is responsible for creating high\-quality, on\-brand visual content across digital, print, retail, advertising, and promotional channels.

The ideal candidate is a strong creative thinker who can take a project from initial concept through final production while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. They should be equally comfortable designing a digital advertisement, retail sign, direct\-mail piece, brochure, social media graphic, email creative, or large\-format display.

This is a hands\-on production role for someone who understands how design supports broader marketing and business goals. The successful candidate will work closely with the Marketing Manager, marketing team, internal departments, store locations, vendors, and external partners.

This is an existing vacancy within our organization. The successful candidate will work on\-site, with an anticipated start date in late August or early September.

**Pay:** $60,000–$70,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Creative Design and Production**

* Design marketing materials for digital, print, retail, social media, email, web, events, and advertising campaigns.
* Create digital advertisements for platforms such as Meta, Google, display networks, and other paid media channels.
* Develop print materials including flyers, brochures, direct\-mail pieces, catalogues, postcards, signage, price tags, banners, and point\-of\-purchase materials.
* Create social media graphics, campaign visuals, promotional assets, and branded templates.
* Design creative for email campaigns, landing pages, website banners, and other digital marketing initiatives.
* Produce large\-format materials for retail locations, trade shows, tent sales, special events, and community initiatives.
* Prepare artwork for print and digital production while ensuring files meet all technical specifications.
* Coordinate with printers, signage providers, media partners, and other vendors when required.
* Review proofs and final files to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality before production.

**Brand Management**

* Maintain and apply Pioneer Family Pools’ brand standards across all marketing materials.
* Support the visual identities of additional brands, product categories, locations, and business divisions as required.
* Ensure all creative is consistent, professional, accessible, and appropriate for the intended audience and channel.
* Organize and maintain brand assets, templates, photography, logos, fonts, and design files.
* Help evolve the company’s visual style while maintaining brand recognition and consistency.

**Campaign and Team Support**

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative concepts for seasonal campaigns, product launches, promotions, events, and sales initiatives.
* Translate campaign objectives and creative briefs into effective visual materials.
* Adapt creative concepts into multiple formats, sizes, channels, and regional versions.
* Support store locations and internal departments with approved marketing materials.
* Prioritize requests based on business needs, deadlines, campaign schedules, and available resources.
* Manage several projects simultaneously while communicating clearly about timelines, requirements, and potential delays.
* Contribute creative ideas during campaign planning and marketing discussions.
* Support photography, image selection, basic photo editing, and video or motion design projects when required.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of three years of professional graphic design experience in an in\-house marketing department, agency, retail organization, or similar environment.
* Diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Interactive Media, or a related field.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating experience across both digital and print design.
* Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Strong understanding of print production, file preparation, colour management, resolution, bleed, and vendor specifications.
* Experience designing for digital advertising, social media, email, websites, and responsive environments.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, branding, and visual storytelling skills.
* Ability to work within established brand standards while also bringing forward new creative ideas.
* Excellent attention to detail, including proofreading, alignment, consistency, and production accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to receive feedback professionally and apply revisions efficiently.
* Experience with HubSpot an asset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within retail, home improvement, lifestyle, recreation, consumer products, or a multi\-location business.
* Experience creating retail signage, direct mail, catalogues, brochures, or large\-format graphics.
* Experience with Canva and developing templates for use by non\-designers.
* Experience with HubSpot, Asana, or similar marketing and project\-management platforms.
* Experience with basic video editing, animation, motion graphics, or Adobe After Effects.
* Experience designing landing pages, email templates, or web assets with an understanding of user experience and conversion principles.
* Photography or photo\-retouching experience.
* Familiarity with accessibility and digital design best practices.

**Key Competencies**

* Creative thinking
* Attention to detail
* Brand consistency
* Project management
* Collaboration
* Adaptability
* Accountability
* Communication
* Time management
* Problem solving

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means consistently delivering accurate, visually strong, on\-brand creative that supports marketing campaigns, store needs, lead generation, and company sales goals. The Graphic Designer will be expected to balance creativity with efficiency and contribute ideas that strengthen Pioneer Family Pools’ overall brand presence.

Accommodations will be provided upon request.*

* Dental care
* Extended health care
* Vision care

Job Description: **Baycrest Long\-Term Care**

  



has an exciting opportunity for a

  


**Manager, Recreation,**


**Arts and Life Enrichment**

  


**Posting Number:** 10009


**Position Type:** Permanent Full\-Time


**Shift Type:** Days, No Weekends


**Bi\-Weekly Hours:** 70 Hours, 7 hrs/shift


**Union:** Non\-Union


**Date Posted:** July 15, 2026


**Internal Closing Date:** July 22, 2026

  


**About Us**



At Baycrest, we believe every older adult deserves care that honours who they are as an individual. Our care teams work closely with residents, families and caregivers to provide personalized support in a safe and compassionate environment.



Guided by our Jewish heritage, we are proud to offer our diverse community of residents care that helps each person live with meaning and dignity. Each floor has small, home\-like spaces that make it easy to enjoy flexible schedules for meals, activities and personal care based on need and preference.

  




**Job Summary**



Reporting to the Chief Heritage \& Quality Officer, the Manager, Recreation, Arts and Life Enrichment will work collaboratively with staff, physicians and members of the leadership team to ensure alignment between corporate and program strategic and operational priorities. As an integral member of the Baycrest Hospital management team, this manager acts as the designated lead for the recreation program under the Fixing Long\-Term Care Act and is responsible for recruitment/hiring activities, performance management, overseeing culture, arts, and recreation program planning/implementation/program evaluation and, driving innovation activities.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Provide program leadership for the recreation, culture and arts team
* Ensure services comply with legislation, accreditation standards and organizational policies
* Collaborate with the team to envision, design and oversee recreation and life enrichment programs
* Develop an annual workplan for the department with annual improvement goals and targets
* Oversee daily operations including assigning staff to lead programs and projects, ensuring coverage through staffing appropriately, and providing operational oversight throughout the portfolio
* Reviews key performance indicators and identifies opportunities for continuous quality improvement; leads improvement initiatives within the portfolio
* Propose and promote evidence informed best practices r to most effectively serve the needs of the Baycrest community
* Identify opportunities for innovative service and/or program enhancement
* Liaises with internal stakeholders as well as external community to expand holistic program enrichment offerings and service enhancements; build partnerships with organizations, entertainers, schools etc.
* Liaises with external business, cultural and art\-based agencies and academia to build and maintain partnerships
* Manage budgets
* Prepare reports and presentations for Senior Leadership
* Works closely with the Foundation to identify funding opportunities including grant and proposal writing, business cases and annual reports on funded activities

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as, but not limited to Social Sciences, Recreation, Leisure, Gerontology, Kinesiology, or an Arts Discipline with experience integrating Health and Arts
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading large, inter\-professional teams
* Previous experience in Health Care, particularly a complex health care facility (Hospital and/or Long\-Term Care facility) is an asset.
* Previous proposal / business case writing experience.
* Experience in the research process: obtaining research grants, budgeting and financial management/tracking, Research Ethics submissions, participant engagement \& informed consent processes, and presentations.
* An understanding of academia, museums, fine arts, granting agencies, health facilities, therapeutic recreation, and professional arts
* Skills in partnership development and innovative program development
* Strength in balancing multiple projects with varying deadlines simultaneously
* Ability to foster interdepartmental collaborations
* Leadership in team environment, affective team building skills

  


**Compensation**



At Baycrest, we take pride in ensuring our compensation structure is internally equitable and compliant with pay equity legislation. We believe compensation should be transparent, equitable, and reflective of your experience and growth. Our salary ranges are structured to support progression, from learning the role to demonstrating full proficiency.



The salary range for this position is $102,072 to $127,590 per year.



Your placement within the target hiring range will depend on your job\-related knowledge, skills, abilities, and relevant education and experience, as well as considerations such as market conditions and internal equity. The starting salary will be determined using these factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization.

Job Description: **Job Details**  

Permanent Full Time (CUPE 1329\)

**Posting Status**  

Open to all current Town of Oakville employees and external applicants

**Closing Date**  

Applications for this position must be received at oakville.ca by no later than 11:59 p.m. on **July 23, 2026\.**


This job posting is for an existing vacancy and therefore will be filled accordingly.

  

Located on Lake Ontario within the Greater Toronto Area, Oakville is a rapidly growing municipality with a vibrant and dynamic community, making it a great place to live, work, and play.


Benefits of working for the Town include:

* An inclusive work environment with excellent community facilities conveniently located
* Competitive compensation and benefits
* A focus on maintaining a healthy work\-life balance and supporting employees
* Opportunities to work within a community dedicated to providing quality service to residents
* Opportunities for advancement and professional development
* The chance to work with leading\-edge technology and the latest business application tools
* The opportunity to work with great people in a supportive and fun environment

  

Reporting to the Manager, Oakville Centre for the Performing Arts, the Coordinator, Audience and Artist Services is responsible for the coordination and delivery of front of house services at the Oakville Centre for the Performing Arts. This position supports a safe, welcoming, accessible, and high\-quality experience for patrons, artists, rental clients, sponsors, volunteers, and members of the public.


The Coordinator oversees front of house operations, including part\-time staff and volunteer coordination, concessions, hospitality, receptions, contractor coordination, event readiness, and patron services. The role also supports the administration and coordination of professional event contracts, artist hospitality, settlements, and related operational requirements.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee front of house operations for performances, rentals, receptions, meetings, and special events at the Oakville Centre for the Performing Arts.
* Ensure a high standard of customer service, safety, accessibility, and operational readiness for patrons, rental clients, artists, sponsors, volunteers, and staff.
* Supervise part\-time front of house staff, including recruitment, onboarding, training, scheduling, work assignments, performance support, and day\-to\-day employee relations.
* Coordinate, schedule, and provide direction to volunteers supporting front of house operations and events.
* Prepare event\-specific front of house instructions, house notes, schedules, staffing plans, and operational details for house managers, staff, volunteers, and service providers.
* Act as senior house manager for scheduled events, including opening and closing the facility, coordinating front of house activities, resolving patron, artist, and rental client concerns, and responding to urgent operational issues.
* Coordinate event hospitality and front of house requirements, including receptions, catering, merchandise sales, lobby and studio setup, artist tickets, transportation, accommodations, and related arrangements.
* Support the administration and coordination of professional event contracts, including reviewing and distributing contract information, gathering internal feedback, coordinating requirements with agents and artists, and preparing related documentation for execution.
* Coordinate payments, settlements, deposits, final payments, merchandise settlements, cash summaries, invoice charges, and other financial documentation in accordance with Town processes.
* Manage concessions operations, including product selection, inventory, pricing recommendations, bar operations, cash handling, and revenue tracking.
* Monitor and support the front of house budget, including revenue\-generating activities, cost estimates, vendor coordination, purchasing, invoicing, and related financial processes.
* Coordinate service providers and contractors, including janitorial, security, catering, equipment maintenance, and other event\-related supports.
* Support tendering and purchasing processes related to front of house operations, equipment, supplies, contracted services, and building maintenance needs.
* Ensure front of house operations comply with applicable legislation, Town policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, accessibility standards, emergency procedures, and alcohol service requirements.
* Prepare, update, and implement front of house procedures, training tools, and operational practices to support consistent service delivery.
* Liaise regularly with box office, technical, marketing, finance, payroll, purchasing, facility staff, rental clients, artists, agents, vendors, contractors, sponsors, inspectors, and emergency services as required.

* Provide support to production as required to address process, quality, equipment, launch, or operational concerns.
* Support Yield and Utilization teams, cross\-functional teams, APQP, ECN, SRED, and program launch deliverables for the Paint Department.

* Completion of a university degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or related Engineering field required, or equivalent experience.

* Proven experience in leading and managing teams to achieve organizational goals and objectives

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of paint processes, production tooling, automated robotic manufacturing processes, and related equipment.
* Experience in OEM paint processes preferred.
* Previous experience with data analysis, financial analysis, reporting, and performance tracking required.

description: *OCAD University acknowledges the ancestral territories of the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Haudenosaunee, the Anishinaabeg and the Huron\-Wendat, who are the original owners and custodians of the land on which we live, work, and create.*


OCAD University, Canada’s largest and oldest art and design university, is a vibrant community of bold, curious and compassionate artists, designers and scholars who are imagining and creating a joyful, equitable and sustainable world. The University is an internationally renowned hub for art, design, digital media, research, innovation and creativity, and arts administration. It embraces collaborative and interdisciplinary approaches to change\-making through art, design\-thinking curriculum and research, making OCAD U a local, regional, national and global leader in art and design.


It is an exciting time to join the OCAD U community as the University is at a key stage in its institutional transformation, with the implementation of its Academic and Strategic Plan and guiding principles — driving positive impact; decolonization, indigenization and equity; environmental sustainability; emerging as a vibrant hub; student centered approaches; innovation in learning teaching and research; and financial stewardship.


The Faculty of Arts and Science invites applications for the following anticipated course offering in the Fall/Winter 2026\-27 term:

**IVCV\-3002 Sovereign Screen (0\.5 Credits)**  

(*Winter 2027: 2027\-01\-11 \- 2027\-04\-09; Tuesdays 6:30 p.m. \- 9:30 p.m.;* *In\-Person**)*

**COURSE DESCRIPTION:** This course will survey the unique approaches to film and new media examined and produced though an Indigenous lens. This class will consider how Indigenous artists and filmmakers engage with local and global strategies of colonization/decolonization, cultural revitalization, storytelling and social engagement through digital technology, video and film. Topics such as visual, cultural, queer and gender issues in relation to land, language, representation, sovereignty, human rights and spirituality will be explored.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:** Teaching and teaching\-related responsibilities may include but are not limited to: course outline development, studio preparation and delivery inclusive of lectures, critiques, grading, mid\-term evaluations and final evaluations/reviews; including responsibility for health \& safety and meeting academic and curricular requirements and deadlines.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* The successful applicant should have a terminal degree in art, design or relevant discipline and/or equivalent professional/practical experience
* Experience teaching at the post secondary level is considered an asset, equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills
* Demonstrated leadership and experience promoting a respectful and inclusive work and learning environment for students, staff, and faculty

 **TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT:** Sessional appointments are fixed\-term annual contracts. Sessional compensation includes a per\-course pay scale with salary level of $7,508\.00 (per 0\.5 credit course) plus 7% in lieu of benefits and vacation pay, per the provisions of the Employment Standards Act. These positions are subject to budgetary approval and satisfactory enrolment levels.

**Applications must include the below materials as one continuous document in PDF format:**

*The PDF file must include the following:*

* A letter of intent stating the candidate’s interests in the areas of teaching by identifying relevant courses above;
* A curriculum vitae;
* A statement of teaching philosophy that responds to the profile of the position;
* A **link or web address** to your digital portfolio of recent and current work/publications (if applicable)
* And the names and contact information of three references.

*Please upload all five (5\) components (including the URL to work)* ***as one PDF****. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please name your upload:* *FirstName\_LastName\-Job Code*


Interested applicants are invited to submit their application in confidence, addressed to Faculty of Arts \& Science Appointments Committee, online.

**Please apply no later than Wednesday August 5th, 2026 at 11:59 PM.**

***Applicants must be eligible to work in Canada for any employer (with a valid work or study permit, SIN and Canadian bank account).***


If you require **application** support, please contact the People \& Culture Office. ***Please note*** that People \& Culture **cannot update you on the status of your application** as these searches are decentralized to their respective Faculty offices. **You will only be contacted if you are shortlisted for an interview. If the posting is advertised, we are still accepting applications.**

 *As an institution committed to art, design, digital media and related scholarship, OCAD University (OCAD U) recognizes the profound and essential value that diversity brings to the creation, reception and circulation of creative practices and discourse. OCAD U understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are essential to and enrich the institution’s core mission and vision as an art and design university with a local and global scope.*

*As an employer committed to employment equity, we encourage applications from members of equity\-deserving communities including women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions.*

***We encourage members of designated equity\-deserving groups to self\-identify within the voluntary Applicant Questionnaire****.*

***In order to alleviate the under\-representation of racialized and Indigenous faculty, priority in hiring will be given to qualified racialized and Indigenous persons who self\-identify as such in the application process. This initiative is a special program under the Ontario Human Rights Code.***

*OCAD U is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free experience to applicants with accessibility needs. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage during the recruitment process. Please* contact *People \& Culture for more information or refer to* OCAD U’s Policy of Accommodation in Employment for Persons with Disabilities

*All qualified persons are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents of Canada will be given priority. While we thank all candidates for their interest, only those short\-listed will be contacted.*

Job Description: *OCAD University acknowledges the ancestral territories of the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Haudenosaunee, the Anishinaabeg and the Huron\-Wendat, who are the original owners and custodians of the land on which we live, work and create*

***Please note that internal job postings are open only to current permanent OPSEU Local 576 Unit 1 employees and temporary OPSEU Local 576 Unit 1 employees with one year of continuous service.***


Reporting to the Manager, Business Strategy, the Program Development Specialist develops non\-credit learning opportunities that highlight the value and increase the profile of OCAD University’s (OCAD U) community of artists and designers. The incumbent supports the development of market\-driven, innovative non\-credit learning opportunities in art \& design that meet the aspirations of learners and emerging creatives, while enhancing OCAD U’s local, national and global impact. This role emphasizes the engagement of alumni, industry and community partners in program development and special projects and works within a business development context to ensure programs are sustainable and return value to OCAD U.


**Summary of Responsibilities**:

*Program Development, Research, and Admin*

* Collaborate closely with faculty, industry professionals, and stakeholders to develop specialized non\-credit programs and courses tailored to the needs and aspirations of mid\-career, emerging professionals in art and design and other potential learner segments that hold strategic value to OCAD U
* Work closely with international partners to develop and deliver short courses, workshops and residencies
* Support the delivery of existing non\-credit programs, including supporting incoming participants with registrations, drafting and distributing relevant communications, and general support, through the CRM and Registrations systems
* Work closely with the Manager to ensure programs are financially sustainable and are relevant to new and emerging markets
* Lead the development and submission of grant applications and other external funding opportunities, serving as the primary point of contact and consulting with the Manager as required
* Assess and advise on the viability and feasibility of new learning opportunities as consulted
* Prepare budget proposals, monitor expenditures, and ensure fiscal responsibility in accordance with university policies; provide administrative support in managing program budgets, financial resources, and procurement processes
* Recruit, onboard, and support a diverse team of instructors and industry experts who bring practical experience and specialized knowledge to the classroom; ensure programs integrate opportunities for alumni engagement
* Provide insights, data, and reports to inform strategic marketing, branding, and advertising opportunities
* Work closely with the Manager and Director, Learning Pathways, to research, identify and propose networks, partnerships and relationships that enhance the relevance of art \& design education for lifelong learners and workforce development across various sectors
* Develop and advance new and existing learner\-centred frameworks and design thinking principles to invite and develop emerging, market\-relevant learning opportunities.
* Work with campus stakeholders (e.g., School of Continuing Studies, Admissions, Recruitment) to map program proposals against other offerings, policies, and procedures to ensure they are distinct, have a clear value proposition, and are viable
* Work closely with Marketing \& Communications to create communication and marketing materials that are relevant to learners, promote enrolment in special programs, increase program visibility, and attract prospective learners, as needed

*Relationship Development*

* Cultivate relationships with alumni to encourage their participation in non\-credit program development, advisory activities, and guest lectures
* Collaborate with the Alumni Relations team to ensure alumni relationships are cultivated at an institutional level
* Support the development and implementation of the strategic development plan by coordinating and facilitating engagement activities with key partners through events, public engagements, workshops, and co\-design sessions

*Student\-Centred Advising and Support*

* Provide support and guidance to learners for program selection, application, and registration as needed, including 1:1 advising, presentations and review of supplemental application material (ie. portfolios, written statements).
* Work with the Manager to determine the admissibility and readiness of learners to enrol in application\-based programs.
* Contribute to the development of diversity, equity, inclusivity, and accessibility (DEIA) strategies throughout all programs, services and communications
* Support marketing and recruitment events, activities and initiatives as needed, which may include occasional weekend and evening hours.

Support the Manager and Director in other related projects that contribute to the successful operation of the Admissions, Recruitment and Continuing Studies departments.  
* 

  

***Qualifications****:*

* Master’s degree in Art, Design, Education, or a related field
* Four (4\) years of experience in program management, preferably in adult learning environments
* Demonstrated expertise in developing and delivering educational programs tailored to mid\-career professionals
* Demonstrated research and analytical skills, including the ability to assess market trends, learner needs, and emerging opportunities
* Experience with the LMS; experience with the CRM and registration system is required
* Strong understanding of curriculum development, instructional design, and educational best practices
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and build strong partnerships
* Experience developing and sustaining strategic partnerships that support program development, learner engagement, and organizational objectives
* Commitment to fostering a supportive and inclusive learning environment
* Commitment to support research\-driven projects in cross functional teams
Demonstrated commitment to the principles of equity and diversity and experience promoting a respectful work and learning environment for student, staff, and faculty  
* 

**Compensation:**OPSEU Unit I, Appendix B, Grade B2; $66,925\.74 to $87,958\.44 per annum

**Hours of Work:** Monday to Friday, for a total of 35 hours per week. Occasional evening and weekend work will be required, with shift premiums applied in accordance with the Collective Agreement. All flexibility and scheduling provisions are subject to the terms outlined in the Collective Agreement.

**Mode of Work:** On campus, 3 days per week. This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangements; however, a minimum of four days per week of on\-campus work is required, with flexibility to adjust on\-campus days and hours to meet department needs.

**This posting is for an existing vacancy.**


Interested **internal permanent OPSEU Local 576 Unit 1 or temporary OPSEU Local 576 Unit 1 employees with one year of continuous service applicants** are invited to submit an updated \*resume and cover letter (**PDF**) , no later than **Tuesday July 21****st****, 2026\.**

* *Please upload your resume and cover letter* ***as one PDF****. Please name your upload:* *FirstName\_LastName\-Job Code*

 *As an employer committed to employment equity, we encourage applications from members of equity\-deserving communities including women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions.*

*OCAD University is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free experience to applicants with accessibility needs. Please* *contact* *People \& Culture for more information or refer to* *OCAD U’s Policy of Accommodation in Employment for Persons with Disabilities*.

*All qualified persons are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents of Canada will be given priority. While we thank all candidates for their interest, only those short\-listed will be contacted.*

Job Description: The Centre for Addiction and Mental Health (CAMH) is Canada’s largest mental health and addiction teaching hospital and one of the world’s leading research centres in mental health and addiction. The Campbell Family Mental Health Research Institute (CFMHRI) brings together multidisciplinary scientists to advance discovery and improve outcomes for people affected by mental illness.


We are seeking an exceptional full\-time, contract (12 months) Scientific Associate to support the launch and development of CAMH’s inaugural Women’s Mental Health Discovery Hub. This role will report to the Treliving Family Chair in Women’s Mental Health to strengthen institute\-wide research capacity and ensure rigorous application of the scientific method across study design, analysis, interpretation, and knowledge translation.


The position is ideal for an interdisciplinary doctorate\-level subject matter expert in women’s mental health and addictions \& sex and gender\-informed research who is committed to methodological rigor, collaborative science, and advancing women’s mental health research across the lifespan.


The Women’s Mental Health Discovery Hub (the “Hub”) is an institute\-wide initiative designed to connect and strengthen existing CAMH research programs through sex and gender\-informed science.


Rather than replacing existing centres, the Hub integrates them by providing scientific expertise, coordination, and shared infrastructure to accelerate discovery in women’s mental health across the lifespan, including hormonal transitions and intersecting biological, genetic, molecular, psychological, and social determinants of health.


The Scientific Associate will support the development and implementation of the Women’s Mental Health Discovery Hub. Working with investigators, trainees, and institutional partners, the successful candidate will help build collaborative research capacity, strengthen grant competitiveness, and support the integration of women’s health, sex\- and gender\-informed approaches across CAMH research programs.


  
Responsibilities

Support the launch and ongoing development of the Hub


Contribute to institute\-wide scientific strategy and research integration


Identify opportunities for cross\-program collaboration and capacity building


Support development of shared infrastructure, tools, and internal funding initiatives


Provide expertise in sex and gender\-informed research design, methods, and analysis


Support development of rigorous, ethical, and inclusive research protocols


Advise on study design, measurement, and data management across mental health and addictions disciplines


Support clinical integration of women’s mental health and addictions research


Promote best practices in research ethics, governance, and data stewardship


Co\-develop interdisciplinary grant applications and research proposals


Support manuscripts, presentations, and scholarly outputs


Contribute to dissemination and knowledge translation activities


Engage with academic, clinical, community, and lived\-experience partners


Translate complex findings for diverse scientific and non\-scientific audiences


Coordinate scientific activities across collaborative research projects


Provide methodological support across research programs


Support project planning, implementation, and reporting


Mentor trainees and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative research environment


  
Qualifications
* PhD in Neuroscience, Psychology, Epidemiology, Translational Science, Genetics, Computational Science, Biostatistics, Health Services Research, or related field
* 1 year of relevant research experience
* Demonstrated expertise in sex\- and gender\-informed research and/or women’s mental health and addictions
* Experience in qualitative, quantitative, or mixed\-methods research design and analysis
* Strong publication record and experience contributing to successful grant applications
* Experience working in interdisciplinary research environments
* Knowledge of research ethics, data governance, privacy, and responsible conduct of research
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience mentoring trainees or junior staff is an asset
* Experience with implementation science or evaluation methods is an asset

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* **Salary is competitive and based on experience, with a hiring range of** $93,822\.73 – $117,278\.41 per year.
* **Employees in this role may progress within the full pay range of** $93,822\.73 – $140,734\.09 per year
* **CAMH’s Total Rewards** : Includes participation in **HOOPP defined benefit pension plan** , flexible work arrangements, and ongoing professional development support.

*This role allows professionals to apply their expertise in a mission\-driven environment dedicated to public health outcomes.*

Job Description  

  

  

**Position Summary**

McMaster University is seeking a senior, collaborative, and accomplished leader for the position of Associate Vice\-President, Research, Accelerated Commercialization and Entrepreneurship (AVPR\-ACE). Reporting to the Vice\-President, Research, the AVPR\-ACE is a key member of the University’s senior leadership team and a key position that will be responsible for advancing commercialization, entrepreneurship, research partnerships, and innovation\-driven impact across the institution.


The AVPR\-ACE provides enterprise\-wide leadership to strengthen McMaster’s innovation ecosystem, accelerate the translation of research into societal and economic benefit, and advance partnerships with industry, government, hospitals, and community organizations. The role supports McMaster’s Strategic Research Plan, positioning the University as a global leader in research impact and inclusive innovation.


The **ideal candidate** for this role is someone who has personally navigated the entrepreneurial ecosystem. This includes having founded or co\-founded a company, successfully advanced innovations through the intellectual property (IP) process, and worked within or alongside startup accelerators/incubators. Equally important is an understanding of the realities of building and scaling ventures, including securing investment, developing partnerships, and translating ideas into commercial outcomes.


While founder experience is highly valued, an **exceptional candidate** would further distinguish themselves by having leveraged that entrepreneurial background within an academic or research\-intensive environment. This could include leading commercialization initiatives at a university or research institution, partnering closely with researchers to translate academic discoveries into commercial ventures, supporting the creation and growth of campus\-based startups, or helping to build an innovation ecosystem that connects faculty, industry, funding partners, and entrepreneurs. This combination of lived entrepreneurial experience and a demonstrated ability to foster innovation within an academic setting represents the unique blend of leadership and credibility required to advance McMaster's commercialization and entrepreneurship agenda.

Job Description  

  

  

**Unit/Project Description**

The Circles of Care Project, a collaborative opportunity between the McMaster University Department of Medicine, Six Nations Internal Medicine Rapid Assessment Clinic, and the Indigenous Health Learning Lodge, as part of the 2015 Truth and Reconciliation Calls to action 23 and 24 aims to address the ongoing educational needs of medical learning and health care professionals to respect and integrate Indigenous healing practices and ensure mandatory Indigenous Health Education. Abiding by the principles of the Two Row Wampum and Indigenous Ways of Knowing of local Indigenous communities, multiple views are critical to this work, including Indigenous Research Methodologies and practices. We are currently seeking a part time, Research Assistant (I) to engage in a research process guided by OCAP (R) and CARE principles to gather and analyze data of focus groups, interviews and program evaluation. Familiarity with qualitative research, Indigenous Health Research Methodologies and NVivo would be an asset.


**Job Summary**

Responsible for organizing and administering one or more research projects within required deadlines under the direction of a Principal Investigator or project leader.


**Purpose and Key Functions**

* Oversee the collection, entry, verification, management, analysis, and reporting of data.
* Use statistical software to analyze data and interpret results.
* Design and maintain databases, data collection forms, error checking methods and related programs for efficient collection, analysis, and reporting.
* Modify and reconfigure databases to ensure the optimal storage of data and minimize data entry complexities.
* Troubleshoot moderately complex computer problems.
* Write data management and operations documentation for the project.
* Liaise between the project centre and remote project sites and personnel.
* Conduct structured project participant interviews.
* Ensure that the relevant research methodology is applied and all research material is handled in accordance with established protocols, policies, and procedures.
* Participate in the development of promotional strategies and related materials to encourage participation and support for research projects.
* Develop presentations and present information and training sessions to project personnel and project participants.
* Keep project participants informed of project progress through regular reports and newsletters.
* Gather and compile information and data required for the preparation of scientific papers, abstracts, and graphs.
* Conduct literature searches.
* Oversee the extraction and compilation of data required for reports and disseminate data to research groups and collaborating partners.
* Implement and maintain the research project budget. Create financial projections and make adjustments to the research project budget throughout the fiscal year.
* Exercise appropriate budget controls, monitor, and reconcile accounts.
* Write a variety of letters and memos.
* Participate in research project meetings and propose recommendations for procedure modifications and development in the areas of data management, quality control, and assurance.
* Write, update, and archive data management and quality assurance conventions.
* Respond to inquiries received from project personnel regarding relevant project issues and procedures.

**Supervision**

* Provide direction to others in how to carry out work tasks.
* Provide orientation and show procedures to others.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field of study.
* Requires 2 years of relevant experience.

**Assets**

* Familiarity with Indigenous Health Research Methodologies, and an understanding of the First Nations Principles of Ownership, Control, Access, and Possession (OCAP®) is considered an asset.
* Strong interpersonal skills and cultural humility when working with Indigenous communities, including Elders, traditional healers, and youth.
* Experience in community\-based participatory research (CBPR) or mixed\-methods research, especially in educational or health\-related settings.

**Additional Information**

The successful candidate must have/demonstrate:


* Operates within the principles of cultural safety; and is knowledgeable of Indigenous Peoples cultures
* Support Indigenous community engagement activities, including coordination with Elders, Knowledge Holders, and the Six Nations Department of Well\-being, ensuring culturally respectful communication and logistics.
* Knowledge and experience with systematic review methods:
	+ Implementing methods as outlined in a systematic review protocol.
	+ Screening literature search results.
	+ Understanding bias and performing risk of bias assessments.
	+ Data extraction from included articles, performing meta\-analysis.
	+ Involved in writing a draft review report.
* Experience in using quality appraisal tools for guidelines.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Strong written and oral communications skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a research team environment.
* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft Office, Word, and Excel

Job Description: **Job Overview**

The Child Behavioural Health Research Lab (CBL) at the Ontario Institute for Studies in Education (OISE), University of Toronto, is dedicated to advancing evidence\-based prevention and treatment for children with emotional and behavioural difficulties and their families. Led by Dr. Brendan Andrade, the Lab conducts innovative clinical research that bridges science and practice to improve mental health outcomes in clinic and community settings.

An exciting opportunity is available for a Casual Clinical Therapist to join the CBL and contribute to a Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR) funded randomized clinical trial to personalize parenting intervention. Reporting to Dr. Brendan Andrade, the Clinical Therapist will deliver virtual, evidence\-based group parenting interventions for parents experiencing depression who have children with emotional and behavioural difficulties. The successful candidate will receive specialized training and ongoing consultation in evidence\-based parent interventions while contributing to innovative research with the potential to shape the future of family mental health care.

**Summary of Duties, but not limited to:**

The Clinical Therapist will work closely with the Principal Investigator, graduate students, and the study team.

Responsibilities are outlined below:

Clinical Responsibilities:

* Performs clinical activities that may include:
* Facilitating multi\-week virtual evidence\-based group treatment (with a co\-facilitator)

Note: Training and ongoing consultation will be provided

* Conducting clinical assessments of research participants
* Administering study questionnaires and tasks
* Creating treatment plans
* Completing clinical documentation as appropriate
* Acts as an expert mental health clinical resource to trial team members and participants.
* Acts as a point of contact for research participant questions related to the clinical intervention being delivered in the study.
* Attends weekly “Community of Practice” meetings to build clinical skills in a supportive setting and shares solutions to address barriers to intervention implementation and maintain treatment fidelity.

As a role model and champion, you will work to identify and integrate safe, best practices into daily activities to foster the delivery of safe and exemplary care.

The responsibilities described above are representative and are not to be construed as all\-inclusive.

**Experience**

* Graduate degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Member in good standing of a relevant psychotherapeutic regulatory college (e.g., College of Psychologists and Behaviour Analysts of Ontario, College of Nurses of Ontario, College of Occupational Therapists of Ontario, Ontario College of Social Workers and Social Service Workers, College of Registered Psychotherapists of Ontario)
* 3 years of clinical experience in parent and child mental health
* Knowledge of the health care delivery system and community resources is an asset
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and as a member of a team
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* Well\-developed time management with excellent attention to detail
* Highly resourceful and adaptable, with strong judgment, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills, particularly when working under pressure
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to PHIPA
* Professional behavior and communication that meets the standards of the professional regulatory college or association, as applicable
* Experience working with clinical trials specializing in children’s mental health and delivery of virtual interventions is an asset
* Experience with use of technology for the delivery of clinical care is an asset

**Conditions of Employment:** 

* Vulnerable sector screening/police background check required, given work with children and families
* Proof of relevant degree and current, valid registration with applicable regulatory college required prior to start date
* Completion of TCPS\-2 and ICH/GCP required prior to commencing research activities. These will be provided by the CBL if not already completed.

Pay: $40\.00\-$65\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* On\-site parking
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Toronto, ON M5S 1V6

About the program/department/team


The Research Assistant will join an interdisciplinary team of researchers focused on advancing the understanding of lung diseases, including COPD, asthma, and cystic fibrosis. The team uses advanced technologies such as CT and MRI, along with machine learning, to reveal novel spatial and temporal disease dynamics within the lung, providing insights unattainable through conventional tools.


This position will be in the department of Physics within the Faculty of Science. The department is known for expertise in research at the intersection of physics and medicine. They are also expanding the use of physics tools to solve problems within interconnected, complex systems across a broad range of sectors.


The opportunity


This position is full\-time for 1 year with the potential for renewal. Under the supervision of Dr. Miranda Kirby, the Research Assistant’s primary role will be to contribute to collaborative research studies with researchers from Toronto Metropolitan University, St. Michael’s Hospital, the Hospital for Sick Children, University of British Columbia, University of Alberta, McGill, Oregon Health \& Science University, Duke University, etc.


Duties will include but are not limited to:


* Assisting Dr. Kirby with image acquisition protocol development
* Coordinating REB approval and data transfer agreements
* Overseeing data transfer
* Data analysis and measurement curation to transfer to the collaborating sites
* Database management and organization

Qualifications

Job Description: Clinical Trial Associate  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Senior Clinical Trial Associate at ICON Plc, you will support the management and execution of clinical trials by handling a range of administrative and operational tasks.


**What You Will Do:**

You will take ownership of clinical trial management deliverables, applying your expertise to complex challenges.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Providing administrative support for clinical trials, including managing documentation, coordinating meetings, and maintaining trial\-related records.
* Assisting in the preparation and submission of regulatory documents and ensuring compliance with study protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support trial operations and resolve any issues that arise during the course of the study.
* Monitoring and tracking trial progress, including managing site communications and ensuring timely delivery of study materials.
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with site staff and other stakeholders to facilitate smooth trial operations and support overall project success.

**Your Profile:**

You will have a strong foundation in clinical trial management, with the experience to work independently and guide others.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline or healthcare\-related field
* Extensive experience in a clinical trial support role, with a solid understanding of clinical trial processes and regulatory requirements.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects effectively.
* Proficiency in clinical trial management systems and relevant software, with a keen eye for detail in documentation and data management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as required (approximately 10%)

### **En tant qu’Associé(e) Principal(e) aux Essais Cliniques (Senior Clinical Trial Associate) chez ICON Plc**


En tant que **Senior Clinical Trial Associate (CTA Senior)** chez ICON Plc, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le soutien à la gestion et à l’exécution des essais cliniques en assurant diverses activités administratives et opérationnelles essentielles au bon déroulement des études.


### **Vos responsabilités**


Vous assumerez la responsabilité de plusieurs livrables liés à la gestion des essais cliniques, en mettant à profit votre expertise pour relever des défis complexes et contribuer au succès des projets.


**Principales responsabilités :**

* Fournir un soutien administratif aux essais cliniques, notamment en gérant la documentation, en coordonnant les réunions et en maintenant à jour les dossiers liés aux études.
* Participer à la préparation et à la soumission des documents réglementaires, tout en veillant au respect des protocoles d’étude et des exigences réglementaires applicables.
* Collaborer avec les équipes multidisciplinaires afin de soutenir les opérations des essais cliniques et de résoudre les problèmes pouvant survenir au cours des études.
* Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des essais, notamment en gérant les communications avec les sites investigateurs et en veillant à la livraison des matériels d’étude dans les délais requis.
* Développer et maintenir des relations de travail solides avec le personnel des sites et les autres parties prenantes afin de favoriser le bon déroulement des opérations et la réussite globale des projets.

### **Votre profil**


Vous possédez une solide expérience en soutien à la gestion des essais cliniques et êtes capable de travailler de façon autonome tout en accompagnant et en guidant vos collègues lorsque nécessaire.


**Qualifications et expérience requises :**

* Diplôme universitaire (Licence/Bachelor ou équivalent) dans une discipline scientifique pertinente ou un domaine lié à la santé.
* Expérience significative dans un rôle de soutien aux essais cliniques, avec une excellente compréhension des processus de recherche clinique et des exigences réglementaires.
* Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et de gestion des priorités, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches et projets simultanément.
* Maîtrise des systèmes de gestion des essais cliniques (CTMS) et des logiciels pertinents, avec une grande rigueur dans la gestion documentaire et des données.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, en relations interpersonnelles et en résolution de problèmes, avec une capacité démontrée à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes et des intervenants variés.
* Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels occasionnels (environ **10 % du temps** ).
  
  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

OCAD University
,
Canada’s largest and oldest art and design university,
is a vibrant community of bold, curious and compassionate artists, designers and scholars who are imagining and creating a joyful, equitable and sustainable world. The University is an internationally renowned hub for art, design, digital media, research, innovation and creativity, and arts administration. It embraces collaborative and interdisciplinary approaches to change-making through art, design-thinking curriculum and research, making OCAD U a local, regional, national and global leader in art and design.
It is an exciting time to join the OCAD U community as the University is at a key stage in its institutional transformation, with the implementation of its
Academic and Strategic Plan
and guiding principles — driving positive impact; decolonization, indigenization and equity; environmental sustainability; emerging as a vibrant hub; student centered approaches; innovation in learning teaching and research; and financial stewardship.
Reporting to the Manager, Indigenous Student Centre (ISC), the Indigenous Student Success Coordinator is responsible for providing Indigenous students with academic support, referrals to student support services both on and off campus, as well as enhancing Indigenous students’ experience through academic and cultural supports, programming, and activities. The Coordinator is responsive to individual student needs, providing support with financial aid, academic advising, and offering advocacy and guidance with academic and non-academic policies. The Coordinator is responsible for planning and implementing services and programs designed to facilitate the academic success of Indigenous students at OCAD University (OCAD U). The Coordinator works to ensure that Indigenous students are supported with culturally relevant services, working closely with Indigenous Student Centre staff, faculty and OCAD U support services to facilitate open, respectful communication to meet the needs of Indigenous students.  Regular on-site attendance is an essential requirement of this position to ensure accessible, responsive, and culturally appropriate support for students.
Summary of Responsibilities:
Responsible for coordinating, supporting, and enhancing core Indigenous Student Centre weekly programming and workshops aimed at supporting Indigenous students’ social, cultural and emotional wellbeing
Collaborate with the Manager, Indigenous Student Centre and ISC team to create new programs that enhance the Indigenous student experience at OCAD University; support and facilitate the development of student-led programming in partnership with Indigenous students and student monitors.
Maintain a consistent on-campus presence to provide support and referrals to Indigenous students in distress and as needed; act as a liaison between students and available supports
Provide advocacy services and guidance to Indigenous students navigating academic and non-academic policies and processes such as academic misconduct, appeals, and petitions; formally advocate on behalf of Indigenous students and provide support through the relevant policy or process as needed or requested
Provide academic advising, support and information to students pertaining to procedures, program requirements, dates and deadlines; work closely with Student Advising, Office of the Registrar and relevant support units
Maintain current knowledge and comprehensive understanding of relevant academic and non-academic policies and processes including Student Petitions, Grade Appeals, Non-Academic Misconduct Policy, Response to Violent or Threatening Behaviour, Respectful Work and Learning Environment Policy; to effectively support student concerns and referrals to the relevant policy holder when necessary
Maintain proactive communications, including the ISC weekly newsletter, social media accounts and the department’s website, to build awareness, promote events and ensure access to accurate, timely and relevant information; to connect with Indigenous OCAD U students, staff, faculty, alumni, Indigenous communities and partners
Provide information and guidance to Indigenous students regarding internal and external bursaries, awards, financial supports; work closely with the Financial Aid & Awards office, providing referrals as needed
Maintain knowledge of housing supports available for Indigenous OCAD U students; community programs, resources and housing partners
Coordinate Orientation and Welcome events for new students and represent the Indigenous Student Centre at University events.

Track persistence and retention of Indigenous students on an ongoing basis and develop retention plans in collaboration with the Manager, Indigenous Student Centre
Supervise the Centre’s Student Monitors including participating in hiring, managing schedules, performance and approving biweekly time entry
Serve on internal and external committees as needed
Support the Manager, Indigenous Student Centre in other related functions and special projects contributing successful operation of the Indigenous Student Centre

Experience with the administration of Indigenous community programming, education, and arts
Understanding of Indigenous cultural, educational, political, and economic conditions

Proven ability to work independently and participate collaboratively in a team environment
Demonstrated commitment to the principles of equity and diversity, and experience promoting a respectful work and learning environment for students, staff and faculty

At Battersea Power Station, we designed Lift 109, an immersive ascent experience that melds cutting-edge animations, interactive elements, and spatial soundscapes to breathe new life into London’s iconic landmark.

Job Description: **Overview**

We are seeking a talented and innovative 3D Custom Product Designer to join our creative team. The 3D Custom Product Designer is an integral member of our design team, specializing in the creation of custom mixed media art projects within the hospitality industry. This role involves designing and engineering both large and small\-scale art pieces, from in\-room artwork to free standing sculptures. This role requires a blend of innovation, resourcefulness, and teamwork, with a strong focus on managing projects end\-to\-end while adhering to client briefs and project specifications.

**Responsibilities**

* Conceptualization: Develop innovative design concepts for custom mixed media art projects based on client briefs and industry trends and budget limitations.
* Apply strong design sense to create compelling visuals that align with client branding and the aesthetic requirements of hospitality spaces.
* Produce and refine digital and physical prototypes, ensuring the designs are visually striking and practical for installation.
* Work with inhouse designers and project specialists to ensure design concepts are executable, on budget, and meet all deadlines.
* Stay current with design trends and incorporate them into new and existing projects to ensure relevancy and innovation.
* Expert level 3D design software: SketchUp for detailed renderings and drawings.
* Oversee the creation of 3D prototypes, employing methods to refine and validate design concepts.
* Expert level in Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop \& Illustrator
* Familiarity with the manufacturing process, including mixed media artwork techniques such as woodworking, mold making, sculpture, and paint applications.
* Produce precise technical drawings for both internal teams and external vendors, ensuring accurate implementation of designs.
* Develop comprehensive production instructions and methods to guide the manufacturing of custom\-designed products.
* Develop products that are both creative and suitable for mass production while maintaining high artistic standards within budget.

**Experience/Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in digital design, graphic design, or related fields with a strong portfolio showcasing 3D modeling and visual arts projects.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), SketchUp, and other relevant tools.
* Ability to translate conceptual ideas into visually compelling products while adhering to project deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with internal teams and external vendors.
* Post\-secondary education in Industrial Design, Hospitality Design, or a related field; 3\-5 years of relevant experience in a design role.
* Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to transform general concepts into finished, high quality products.
* Strong innovative and problem\-solving skills, with a proactive approach to overcoming design challenges.
* Ability to think creatively and present versatile design solutions tailored to diverse client needs.

This role is ideal for creative professionals passionate about pushing the boundaries of digital art and product design while working in an innovative environment that values artistic excellence and technical skill.

Pay: From $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
